selected.title: JP Morgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum
selected.summary: JP Morgan has brought its deposit token product, JPM Coin, to the Ethereum layer 1 blockchain network.
selected.why: Major Wall Street bank expands flagship deposit token to public permissionless blockchain.

reason: JPM Coin on Ethereum raises real questions about whether public blockchain adoption by major banks signals genuine systemic change or regulatory capture disguised as innovation.
angle: Major banks moving to public blockchains may entrench their market power rather than democratize finance as claimed.
